summary:
U3b FIX round (UY1-UY8) is done in sc-s74-ct between 19:53 and 20:12 AST, with no git write. FIRST, I re-hashed the GREEN report's files and all 24 entries matched (21 tracked M/D + 3 untracked; the deleted test is still absent). There was no lock.

(1) RED-FIRST
- Sheet nodes: aiConsentSheetScroll.s75 was rewritten. Node 3 is amended: it checks the numeric cap round(0.4*h) at two window heights (667 -> 267 and 568 -> 227, so round, floor and ceil differ), the card has no maxHeight, flexGrow is 0, flexShrink is not 0, and there is no height or minHeight. Two new nodes are added: the flash node (a createNodeMock stub; visible false -> true -> busy rerender gives 0, 1, 1 calls; plus persistentScrollbar === true) and the maxFontSizeMultiplier node (1.6 on title, link and both CTA labels; none on the body). These three nodes were red on the GREEN run-2 sheet bytes: 3 failed / 2 passed, with the messages cardMaxHeight '85%', 0 calls, and multiplier undefined.
- One more node beyond the ruling: 'does not flash while an iOS Modal keeps the sheet mounted after visible turns false'. It uses a spied Modal that keeps its children mounted, which models RN 0.81 Modal.js:278-281 on iOS. I added it because mutant F5 (the visible guard removed) survived without it.
- Backend: B5 (UY3) is new. It builds a fresh app.openapi() (openapi_schema saved, cleared and restored) and checks that neither the PreferenceTogglesBody description nor the PUT /api/v1/auth/preference-toggles description matches /opt.?out|PDPL/i. It is red on mutant B17 (it reports both 'PDPL' and 'opt-out') and on B17R (an opt-out sentence added to the route docstring).
- B3 (UY4) now records the constructor kwargs. It asserts there is no api_key, that max_retries == openai_max_retries() with OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES=4 set through monkeypatch so a hard-coded 2 dies, and that timeout == httpx.Timeout(120.0, connect=30.0). It is red on B12E (api_key None present), on B12T (timeout 60), on B12C (connect 10) and on B12R (max_retries=2).
- Both new or amended files are pure ASCII and LF.

(2) PRODUCTION
- AiConsentSheet.tsx (UY1): the card maxHeight is gone. The ScrollView takes ref={bodyScrollRef}, style [bodyScroll {flexGrow 0}, {maxHeight: Math.round(0.4 * useWindowDimensions().height)}] and persistentScrollbar. A useEffect on [visible] calls flashScrollIndicators() when visible is true. The title, link and both CTA labels get maxFontSizeMultiplier={1.6}; the body keeps full scaling.
- UY5 comment-only edits: ProfileScreen.tsx :125-126 and :466-470 now describe one master; Step05Trust.tsx:24 now reads 'organisation shares data with OpenAI, decision D3 = C; no per-user opt-out'.
- Necessary test-infra change, flagged: __mocks__/react-native.ts (the moduleNameMapper target for react-native) had no useWindowDimensions. HomeScreen always renders the sheet, so every such render would throw. I added `export const useWindowDimensions = () => Dimensions.get('window')` and its default-export entry.
- That made the mock a changed file, so the eslint gate surfaced a PRE-EXISTING react/display-name error at :20 (the TextInput forwardRef). I confirmed the same error on the HEAD bytes through --stdin. I added an eslint-disable-next-line comment with the reason.
- openai_service.py and auth_routes.py are unchanged this round (their shas equal GREEN's). The fence still holds at 372c5048...1a02.

(3) MUTANTS: 42 byte-copy mutants were run under the lock .qa-mutation.lock 'u3b-fix', taken and released four times (plus the X1 re-run on the final mock). Every restore sha was OK.
- All non-comment mutants were KILLED by named nodes, including the three CT2-m1 visibility mutants (V1, V2, V3) and the K08 shape.
- Comment-only C1, C2 and C3 SURVIVED as expected (equivalent).
